writer_contracts.summary: Finite nested media, bleed and trim boxes in PDF points.
Ordered moves, lines, cubic curves, closures, fill rules and strokes.
Finite affine transforms and path clipping preserve paint order.
Prepared exact font programs, used CIDs, Unicode mappings and positioned glyph runs.
Bounded exact decoded eight-bit RGB, Gray and CMYK planes with optional independent straight alpha; print rejects unmanaged RGB resources.
Paint alpha, gray masks and isolated group opacity apply once with item-local blending.
Invalid geometry, decoded planes, identities, glyphs, paints, gradients and budgets fail before bytes are returned.
Ordinary output omits PDF/X claims; bounded candidates require a usable embedded CMYK output profile.
Equal finished input and explicit metadata repeat bytes.

Typed generation inputs provide no arbitrary PDF dictionaries, interactive/external constructs, spot colors, tiling patterns, mesh/conical gradients, repeating/reflecting spread or direct encoded image streams.
Native multi-stop axial/radial fills support hard interior transitions, endpoint padding, transforms, clips and independently interpolated authored color/alpha.
All sixteen standard PDF blend modes apply per item and once to completed isolated groups; ordinary blending color is local to each painted page/group.
Each content stream names exactly its direct fonts, images, states, shadings and child Forms; stable shared resources are emitted once.

Supported print output supplies custom output-intent Info and a nonblank title, screens referenced ICC editions, limits decoded content strings to 32767 bytes, executed graphics-state depth to 28 and object references to 8388607.

Retained destinations are bounded to 512 UTF-16BE bytes without a BOM; both emitters write Type 2 ToUnicode maps, use two-byte CID codes and blocks of at most 100 pairs, preserve extraction, and retain Identity-H Encoding.
writer_contracts.authority: PDF Reference 1.6 section 5.9.2; Adobe Technical Note 5099 section 1.3.1
